SV EN FR

This is a translation of the Swedish lyrics and cannot be sung.

1.

Hail to the Lord’s Anointed, The great Son of King David, Who shall accomplish God’s counsel upon His throne! Oppression shall He crush, The captives bring forth, From sins deliver His people of Jacob’s stock.

2.

God’s counsel in the heights The heavens still conceal From our eyes The long-expected One. But He, whose gentle hands Blessed at last, The same shall return And richly fill every lack.

3.

He shall come like the rain And water all the earth, The dry wilderness Shall blossom as the lily. From the pure fountain of life Shall peace for thousands Like streams of water flow Over hills and valleys.

4.

Behold, kings fall down With gold and incense! Behold, the heathen worship In the temple, adoring! And over seas and shores They come to God’s house From all the lands of the earth To behold the Lord’s light.

5.

His kingdom shall remain forever, His praise is new each day. All render Him homage And do His good pleasure. No stream of time shall reverse His covenant of peace, Whose name without end Is and remains Love.

Text: Efter Hail to the Lord’s Anointed av James Montgomery, 1821. Musik: Lymington av Robert Jackson, 1882. 7.6.7.6 D
